reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: deposit_limit_breached is actively called at market.move:278. Gate 2: deposit is a public user-callable entry point, no trust_assumptions restrict it. Gate 3: reserve.move is explicitly in-scope. The double-subtraction is confirmed: total_deposit_plus_interest already equals (cash + debt - cash_reserve) via exchange_rate, so L89 subtracts cash_reserve a second time, making the effective check cash + debt + increment - 2*cash_reserve > limit instead of the correct cash + debt + increment - cash_reserve > limit. An attacker can trigger this via the public deposit entry point by supplying a deposit amount that would push total deposits above max_deposit_amount, but the check passes because cash_reserve is double-subtracted, allowing actual deposits to exceed the cap by up to cash_reserve (grows with protocol fee accumulation).
